digitalTwin.title: National KPI Digital Twin

sentiment.title: Citizen Sentiment Heatmap
sentiment.description: Online news (RSS) and Google News classified by Bangla-BERT — Prothom Alo, Daily Star, BDNews24, and more.
sentiment.recentNewsDesc: Auto-collected from online newspapers and Google News

sentiment.risingDesc: Areas with high grievance ratio from RSS and Google News feeds.

unrest.title: Protest & Public Unrest
unrest.description: Which protests are active where in Bangladesh — by category, district, and casualties.
unrest.movementsSubtitle: By category and place — casualties shown when reported.
unrest.districtChartSubtitle: Longer bars = more protest signals in that district.
unrest.noThemeMovements: Nothing in this category right now.

simulator.title: Cross-Ministry Impact Simulator
simulator.description: Geopolitical or economic shock scenarios — remittance, RMG, agriculture, and energy impact.

procurement.title: Procurement Arbitrage Advisor
procurement.description: Compare landed cost, lead time, and port congestion across sourcing countries.

documents.title: Document Intelligence
documents.description: Government-grade tender & contract audit — PPR 2008 compliance, clause extraction, fraud red flags, and PMO executive brief.
documents.documentPlaceholder: Paste tender notice, contract draft, or BOQ terms (min. 50 characters)…
documents.contractorPatternMatch: Contractor risk pattern — prior flagged awards

antiPhishing.title: Anti-Phishing Shield
antiPhishing.description: Compare suspicious URLs against official government digital signatures — clone lookalikes trigger RED_FLAG.
antiPhishing.scanHint: If similarity ≥ threshold but the domain is not on the verified list, raise a red flag.
antiPhishing.registerHint: Register the curated Bangladesh government seed list (.gov.bd portals & ministries). Domains join the allow-list immediately; HTML signatures are fetched best-effort.
antiPhishing.emptyResult: Scan a URL to see the verdict here.

proximity.title: Proximity Alert Map
proximity.description: Real-time lat/lng → Shapely geofence — alert when tracks enter or approach PMO, Bangabhaban and other sensitive polygons.
proximity.mapHint: Polygons = sensitive campuses. Live VIP tracks refresh ~every 10s. Click the map to drop an analyst pin.
proximity.noAlerts: No INSIDE / APPROACHING alerts right now.

faceIntel.title: Face Intel — VIP Ethical Report Card
faceIntel.description: Detect a face from live camera/upload → profile DB → last-6-month Ethical Report Card (public activity, financial anomalies, complaint signals).
faceIntel.captureHint: Start the webcam and scan a frame, or upload a still. Click a gallery VIP for sample match / NID dossier.
faceIntel.galleryHint: Seed representatives — sample portrait match or NID dossier pull.
faceIntel.galleryEmpty: Gallery empty — is the AI service up?

hazards.title: Flood & Cyclone Project Risk
hazards.description: Live weather, flood/cyclone alerts, and population risk across Bangladesh divisions.
hazards.floodImpactSubtitle: Every named upazila/district from news — deaths, injuries, homes, livestock. Banshkhali is only an example.
hazards.mapTimeHint: Map shows only places with flood/water evidence in the selected window (e.g. Bohoddarhat, Halishahar)
hazards.impactByEventHint: Each bar = one district × day incident (max from headlines)
hazards.impactMethodHint: Every place named in news — deaths, injuries, homes, livestock (max per day)

citizen.title: Citizen Chatbot (333/999)
citizen.description: Citizens write in Bangla → classify → route to ministry or district.
citizen.footerNote: Government channel only — not social media. Sovereign Bangla-BERT routing.

audit.title: Blockchain + AI Audit Trail
audit.description: Red flag → AI explanation → minister action → immutable ledger hash.
